Name: Jen's Small Beach Farm
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- A small, minimalist custom beach farm that doesn't replace any default farm.
- Forage that spawns on the grass and the beach
- All tiles are tillable, beach tiles allows sprinklers
- Beach area allows you to catch ocean fish. Pond on the cliff allows you to catch river fish.
- Custom starter farmhouse
- Support for 4 players

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Starter Gift[/b]: Choose which type of gift you'd like to receive upon starting a new save. Defaults Default[list]
[*]﻿Default: 15 Parsnip Seeds
[*]Fisher: 3 Crab Pots and 20 Bait
[*]Rancher: 20 Hay and 10 Blue Grass Starters
[*]Miner: 1 Furnace, 10 Bombs, and 1 Miner's Treat
[*]Forager: 10 Carrot Seeds and 1 Mushroom Log﻿
[/list]- [b]Ocean Ambience[/b]: Overrides the background music on the farm with the ocean ambience. (True, False) Defaults False
- [b]Starter Coop[/b]: Start with a Coop which includes a single White Chicken named Chowder. (True, False) Defaults False [b]!!MUST HAVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SPACECORE[/url] INSTALLED OR THIS DOES NOTHING!!
[/b]- [b]SVE Grandpa's Shed Warp[/b]: Adds a shortcut near Grandpa's Shrine to Grandpa's Shed if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] installed. (True, False) Defaults True

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Small Beach Farm into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
